title.narrative: Interamerican special rapporteur for freedom of expression, 2024- 2026

description.narrative:
Den Interamerikanska specialrapportören för yttrandefrihet (RFOE), tillhörande den Interamerikanska kommissionen för mänskliga rättigheter (IACHR) under Organisationen för de Amerikanska Staterna (OAS), är det regionala expertorganet med mandat att främja och granska situationen i förhållande till yttrandefrihet, ge expertråd till IACHR angående skydd och åtgärder, samt ta fall till den Interamerikanska domstolen för mänskliga rättigheter (I/A court for H.R.) för främjande och skydd av yttrandefrihet.
Insatsen syftar till att garantera rätten till yttrandefrihet som ett sätt att stärka och upprätthålla demokratiska institutioner och rättsstatens principer i Latinamerika. Detta kommer att göras genom att arbeta mot följande fem mål i enlighet med RFOEs arbetsplan 2023 - 2025:
1. Arbetsflöden och processer för RFOEs kontor upprättas och systematiseras.
2. Expertråd ges till den Interamerikanska kommissionen för mänskliga rättigheter avseende framställningar, ärenden, försktighetsåtgärder och provisoriska åtgärder.
3. Situationen för yttrandefrihet i regionen följs upp.
4. Interamerikanska normer för yttrandefrihet främjas.
5. Expertkunskaper om yttrandefrihet delas och publiceras.

The Office of the Special Rapporteur for Freedom of Expression (RFOE) of the Inter-American Commission for Human Rights (IACHR) under the Organisation of American States (OAS) is the regional expert entity in the region with the mandate to promote and monitor the situation in relation to freedom of expression, provide expert advice to the IACHR regarding precautionary measures and petitions to the Inter-American Court of Human Rights related to the protection of freedom of expression.
The intervention aims at guaranteeing the right to freedom of expression for the strengthening and preservation of democratic institutions and the rule of law in Latin America, this will be done by working towards the following five objectives in accordance with RFOE work plan 2023 - 2025:
1. Work flows and processes of the Office of the RFOE are established and systematized.
2. The IACHR receives expert advice from RFOE for the evaluation of petitions, cases, precautionary, and provisional measures.
3. The situation of freedom of expression in the hemisphere is monitored in a timely manner.
4. Inter-American standards of freedom of expression are widely promoted.
5. Expert knowledge on freedom of expression in produced and published.

sector.narrative: Media and free flow of information

description.narrative:
Through the intervention, the SRFoE has strengthened its institutional capacity to fulfil its mandate by establishing clearer procedures, standardized formats, and improved systems for collecting, registering and safeguarding information related to its mandate. These improvements have increased the Offices ability to operate efficiently and to respond more effectively to critical regional developments affecting freedom of expression.
During 2025, the SRFoE consolidated its capacity to monitor critical situations in countries with severe restrictions to civic space. The Office documented violations to freedom of expression in the postelectoral context in Venezuela, observed the situation of press freedom in Haiti, and monitored developments in Nicaragua and Cuba. This required rigorous documentation, technical processing of information, and sustained engagement with authorities, civil society, and media actors. As a result, rights-holders and other stakeholders gained access to timely and credible information that supports more informed decisionmaking on freedom of expression in these contexts.
The SRFoE also produced country reports on Chile and Brazil during 2025, which facilitated constructive dialogue with authorities and generated recommendations aimed at strengthening guarantees for freedom of expression in both countries. According to the partner, since the start of the project, ten Latin America States have adopted public policy or judicial decisions aligned with standards and recommendations developed by the SRFoE and the InterAmerican Commission on freedom of expression, indicating shifts in State practices and the uptake of interAmerican norms.
In 2025, the SRFoE analyzed 40 requests for precautionary measures, three of which were granted by the IACHR, thereby contributing directly to the protection of individuals at risk. It also advanced the preparation of admissibility and merits reports, with two reports in each category approved by IACHR during the period, enabling cases to progress within the InterAmerican Human Rights system.
The SRFoE further contributed to regional understanding and management of key challenges by producing thematic reports on the impunity for crimes against the press, journalists in exile, the impact of surveillance on freedom of expression, and the implications of artificial intelligence. This analysis strengthens and updates inter-American jurisprudence, particularly regarding emerging technologies, and provides states, civil society organizations, and human rights defenders with tools they were not previously equipped with to address current and evolving threats to freedom of expression.
